column8: OPERATION -- test/prod95_scale.py: every case in a fresh backend at 1x, 2x and 4x rows (P95_ROWS, 50,000) with work_mem as its SETTINGS say; BASE_MB the memory a sampler may miss, TEMP `0` | `max:BYTES_PER_ROW` | `any`, CAP_MB a bound of peak_4x (0: none).
select id, count(*), sum(amount) from {t} group by id order by id limit 10;
select id, count(*), sum(amount) from {t} group by id order by id;
select grp, id, sum(c1) over (partition by grp order by id) from {t} limit 10;
select grp, id, sum(c1) over (partition by grp order by id) from {t};
select grp, txt, rn from (select grp, txt, row_number() over (partition by grp order by txt) rn from {t}) s where rn <= 5;
select grp, ts, sum(c1) over (partition by grp order by ts) from {t};

select g1, g2, g3, g4, o1, o2, o3, o4, row_number() over w, rank() over w, dense_rank() over w, sum(v1) over w, sum(v2) over w, count(v3) over w, min(v4) over w, max(v5) over w from {t} window w as (partition by g1, g2, g3, g4 order by o1, o2, o3, o4);

select g1, g2, g3, g4, o1, o2, o3, o4, row_number() over w, rank() over w, dense_rank() over w, sum(v1) over w, sum(v2) over w, count(v3) over w, min(v4) over w, max(v5) over w from {t} window w as (partition by g1, g2, g3, g4 order by o1, o2, o3, o4);

select count(*) from {t} p where not exists (select 1 from {u} b where b.k = p.k);
